_comment: Balance-of-power baselines for the results page. not_up = seats NOT contested in 2026 (holdovers), by caucus party (independents counted with the party they caucus with). Senate: 100 seats; 35 up in 2026 (22 currently Republican, 13 currently Democratic incl. independents) -> holdovers 31 R / 34 D; 51 to control. House: all 435 up -> no holdovers; 218 to control. results_update.py adds 2026 called/leading results to not_up to compute live control.
